transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Carter, the S-3. We need to finalize the staffing roster for the coordination cell during the upcoming four-day field exercise. As a reminder, the cell runs 0600 to 1800 each day, and we have three desks to fill: partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control. Our available personnel are Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega. Before I publish the final roster, I need to run the routine qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff. I'd like to start by confirming what qualifications each of our three soldiers currently holds, so we can match them to the right desks. Who has that information?
